articles.company_name: Ellington Credit Company Common Shares of Beneficial Interest
articles.summary: OLD GREENWICH, Conn. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Apr. 7, 2026-- Ellington Credit Company (NYSE: EARN) ("we" or the "Fund") today announced that its Board of Trustees has declared a monthly common dividend of $0.08 per share, payable on May 29, 2026 to common shareholders of record as of April 30, 2026.
articles.title: Ellington Credit Declares Monthly Common Distribution
